subject: Re: Acme Health case study & logo use — legal redlines / request for exec decision
messages:
From: Emily Torres <emily.torres@acmehealth.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai; monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@acmehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Case study + logo use — would love to partner (and discuss discount)

Hi Karthik / Monica,

Thanks again for a great proof-of-concept with Redwood — the team at Acme is excited about the latency improvements and cost savings from the pilot. We discussed internally and would love to do a joint case study and allow Redwood to use our logo on your site and materials.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Our legal team wants a short form of wording that limits any implied indemnities and confirms we only share aggregated, non-PHI metrics.
- We usually request first right to review any quote or metric before publication.
- In exchange, we can commit to a joint webinar and a short customer spotlight (quote + logo). Given the marketing lift, we'd like to discuss a one-time commercial concession — specifically a 20% marketing credit applied to our first 6 months of Dedicated capacity.

I've attached a short brief and our legal redlines for your review. If this is something you can approve, please let us know what internal approvers you need to sign off.

Best,
Emily Torres
Director of Product Marketing
Acme Health

Attachments: Acme_CaseStudy_Request_20260719.pdf, Acme_Legal_Redlines.docx

From: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: monica.patel@redwood.ai; stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai; legal@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Case study + logo use — would love to partner (and discuss discount)

Team — forwarding Acme's request. Short summary / ask: Acme will do a joint case study + webinar and wants a 20% marketing credit for 6 months in exchange for logo + quote + webinar. Their legal added a couple of redlines that are non-standard for us (they asked for indemnity language and access to some aggregated telemetry).

Questions for you:
1) Can Deal Desk approve a 20% marketing credit tied to the co-marketing package, or should we cap at 15%?
2) Will Legal accept a limited data-sharing clause (aggregated, anonymized metrics only) and explicitly refuse indemnity language? Acme is pushing for a mutual "no-fault" indemnity in their redlines.

I've attached their redlines and a proposed co-marketing credit sheet. We need an executive decision today so we don't miss their comms window next week.

Thanks — Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
P: 415-555-0132

Attachments: Acme_Legal_Redlines.docx, proposed-co-marketing-credit-sheet.xlsx

From: monica.patel@redwood.ai <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai; stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai; legal@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 18:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Case study + logo use — would love to partner (and discuss discount)

Karthik — quick take from AE perspective: Acme is a high-quality reference in the health space and this has outsized marketing value for us. I recommend we approve a marketing credit but with guardrails:
- Cap at 15% as a standard marketing concession (applied as a credit to invoices, not a discount on list price).
- No indemnity language accepted — our Legal should push back hard here.
- Legal can work with them on an "aggregated metrics" clause; require that any metric be scrubbed of potential PHI and approved by Acme prior to publication.

If the customer insists on 20% I can push for a one-time 20% trade for a 12-month comms commitment (webinar + case study + two social posts), but need Exec signoff for that concession.

- Monica
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai; karthik.iyer@redwood.ai; monica.patel@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Case study + logo use — would love to partner (and discuss discount)

Vivek / Team — tagging you because Acme is in our top-25 strategic targets for healthcare this year. A slightly higher concession now (20% one-time marketing credit) would likely accelerate the expansion opportunity — they're evaluating Redwood for 3 additional lines of business starting Q4.

Proposed path:
- Approve a conditional 20% marketing credit, contingent on Legal removing any indemnity requirement and inserting a short clause that all customer-provided metrics are aggregated and de-identified.
- Marketing & CS commit to the webinar + case study in our joint playbook (we'll own production costs).
- Deal Desk to record the concession as a one-time credit line (not permanent discount).

HubSpot link to deal and materials: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/RDW-3421

If Legal is comfortable with the data language and we make the concession a time-bound credit, I recommend we approve.

— Steph
Head of Sales (Americas), Redwood Inference

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai; monica.patel@redwood.ai; stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: legal@redwood.ai; cs_ops@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Case study + logo use — would love to partner (and discuss discount)

Thanks for the color — all. Final decision: approve a one-time 18% marketing credit (applied as a credit over the first 3 billing cycles of Dedicated capacity) in exchange for the joint case study, webinar, and two social posts. Conditions:
1) Legal must remove any indemnity ask; we will not accept indemnity.
2) Data sharing limited to aggregated, non-PHI telemetry; customer to pre-approve any quote or metric in writing before publication.
3) Marketing to produce the assets and own production costs; CS to own the webinar coordination.
4) Concession to be recorded as a one-time credit in HubSpot (Deal ID RDW-3421) and approved in Deal Desk notes.

Karthik / Monica — please convey this to Acme and ask Acme Legal to submit a redline that reflects the two conditions above (we will then have Legal sign off). If Acme refuses the conditions or insists on indemnity, we walk.

I'll sign off on the 18% as long as Legal confirms the indemnity language is removed.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
